segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I had you down for 42 technician seats and 6 manager seats for the calibration tracking rollout, with the target go-live on May 12. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Close. We added two lab supervisors, so make it 8 manager seats. Technician count stays 42. We also need the first invoice dated after April 1 because that's the new budget period.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 50 total seats, invoice after April 1. On term, the pricing sheet has the 24-month option at $3,850 per month, and that includes the gauge import and the onsite admin training day.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. The training day is important. We want it the week of May 5, ideally Tuesday, because all three shifts overlap for about two hours.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Tuesday May 6 works on our side. I'll put that date in the order notes and the implementation summary, so the kickoff team has it from day one.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. And payment terms are net 30, right? Our purchasing group kicked back one agreement last quarter because it said due on receipt.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, net 30 is standard for this package. The order form will show monthly billing, net 30, starting after the April 1 invoice date you mentioned.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: One more thing. We need the asset import done before training. It's about 6,200 instruments, mostly spreadsheets from our three sites.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That's included. We'll need the files by April 18 to hit the May 12 go-live. If you can send one sample this week, our import specialist can confirm the format before you export everything.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, I can send a sample Thursday. Send me the order form today and I'll route it for signature. Our signer is Mark Ellison, VP of operations.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll send it to you and Mark by 3:00 Central with the 50 seats, 24-month term, $3,850 monthly, net 30, invoice after April 1, and May 6 training. Anything else I should include?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that's the list. If the paperwork matches that, we should be able to sign by Friday.
